summary: SCOBY-D0 remains led by the marine bacterial-cellulose sorbent program while adding a separate exploratory mechanistic track on extremophile reentry-state coupling to BC formation. The new Polypedilum/Pv11 line is frozen at P0 kinetic-anchor status: public evidence supports function-before-proliferation and recovery-associated DNA-repair timing, but no Pv11-to-SCOBY matrix effect has been measured. Promotion requires matched BC experiments that control trehalose, medium carryover, biomass, pH and oxygen.

marine_oil_sorbent.next_gate: Finish matched Stage-0 feedstock/process screen; fabricate 100x100 mm finalists; run M1A fresh-water vs artificial-seawater static test with D2 and commercial controls.

extremophile_reentry_matrix_coupling.current_claim: Recovery-state timing is resolved well enough to define a pre-proliferative test window; matrix modulation is not established.
extremophile_reentry_matrix_coupling.next_gate: Test R1-R3 versus R4 with trehalose, medium-carryover, biomass, pH and oxygen controls plus whole-cell versus cell-free separation.

biopapyrus_and_material_process.claim_boundary: Modern BC sheet research and Egyptian lexical/process parallels do not demonstrate ancient SCOBY papyrus.

marine_promotion_gates: M1_G1 oil uptake in artificial seawater
M1_G4 >=99 percent material retrieval with no hazardous fragmentation
M1_G5 single contained press recovery if claimed

external_validation.followup_policy: Do not resend introductions. Follow up only after a response or after materially new measured data are available.
